item.title: How Wikilinks Work
item.description: Internal links between notes render with [[bracket]] markers. Use absolute /notes/slug/ paths so the resolver finds the target every time.

item.title: Note Maturity Stages
item.description: Kavu uses three labels — seeding, growing, evergreen — to mark how mature a note is. Lower the bar for publishing; raise it for promotion.

item.title: What Is a Digital Garden
item.description: A digital garden is a personal site organised by ideas and links rather than by dates. Notes grow over time.
